sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Ghostfog was once the Titan of the Dutch sailor Captain Bernard Fokke, who went down in history as the Flying Dutchman. Ghostfog's presence inspired many ancient tales about pirates and sailors who claim to have seen a ghost ship sailing across the open sea enveloped in a luminous, ghostly fog. He was left to reside on the Flying Dutchman, the legendary haunted ship. [Huntik Magazine]

Ghostfog's Amulet was found on the Flying Dutchman when Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill searched for it. Upon bonding with the Titan, Lok used Ghostfog to destroy Diaz and Snake's boat, whose team were also intent on recovering it. [The Secret of the Flying Dutchman]

Diaz and his Organization team later returned, determined to recapture Ghostfog's Amulet. After taking Cherit hostage, they forced Dante Vale into handing over the Amulet but it was then recovered by Cherit. [The Bulls of Pamplona]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext: Ghostfog is capable of spinning into a rushing tornado or a whirl of cascading winds, destroying everything in its path. It can grow to large sizes as it is made up of fog. Lightning bursts from his ribcage, and he can envelop his enemies in spirals of energy, unleashing a rain of acid against his opponents.

Ghostfog is a spectral Gaia-Titan made up of fog and smoke that belonged to the Dutch sailor, Captain Bernard Fokke. It left to reside legendary ghost ship, the Flying Dutchman, inspiring many tails of a haunted ship sailing across the ocean.

== History ==
Ghostfog was once the Titan of the Dutch sailor Captain Bernard Fokke, who went down in history as the Flying Dutchman. Ghostfog's presence inspired many ancient tales about pirates and sailors who claim to have seen a ghost ship sailing across the open sea enveloped in a luminous, ghostly fog. He was left to reside on the Flying Dutchman, the legendary haunted ship. [Huntik Magazine]

Ghostfog's Amulet was found on the Flying Dutchman when Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill searched for it. Upon bonding with the Titan, Lok used Ghostfog to destroy Diaz and Snake's boat, whose team were also intent on recovering it. [The Secret of the Flying Dutchman]

Diaz and his Organization team later returned, determined to recapture Ghostfog's Amulet. After taking Cherit hostage, they forced Dante Vale into handing over the Amulet but it was then recovered by Cherit. [The Bulls of Pamplona]

== Abilities ==
Ghostfog is capable of spinning into a rushing tornado or a whirl of cascading winds, destroying everything in its path. It can grow to large sizes as it is made up of fog. Lightning bursts from his ribcage, and he can envelop his enemies in spirals of energy, unleashing a rain of acid against his opponents.
